import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--candidate', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--fixtures', default='imgs_1,imgs_00018069,imgs_00006737')
parser.add_argument('--baseline-total-limit-seconds',type=float,default=60.0)
args = parser.parse_args()
directory = OUT / (args.candidate + '-comparison')
directory.mkdir()
ledger_path = OUT/'ledger.json'
ledger = json.loads(ledger_path.read_text()) if ledger_path.exists() else {
    'baseline': json.loads((OUT/'budget.json').read_text())['baseline_prior_seconds']}
ledger.setdefault(args.candidate, 0.0)
fixtures = args.fixtures.split(',')
versions = {'baseline': OUT/'baseline-benchmark', args.candidate: OUT/(args.candidate+'-benchmark')}
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
source = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in sorted((ROOT/'src').rglob('*.rs'))}

def compare(e, a):
    issues=[]
    for key in ['id','text','detected_count','detector_resized_width','detector_resized_height']:
        if e[key]!=a[key]: issues.append(key)
    if len(e['lines'])!=len(a['lines']): issues.append('lines.length')
    for i,(el,al) in enumerate(zip(e['lines'],a['lines'])):
        for key in ['text','classification_label','applied_rotation_degrees','emitted_count',
                    'recognition_content_width','recognition_tensor_width','recognition_time_steps']:
            if el[key]!=al[key]: issues.append(f'line{i}.{key}')
        for key in ['detection_score','recognition_score','classification_score']:
            if not math.isfinite(al[key]) or abs(el[key]-al[key])>1e-4+1e-4*abs(el[key]):
                issues.append(f'line{i}.{key}: {el[key]} vs {al[key]}')
        for ep,ap in zip(el['points'],al['points']):
            if any(not math.isfinite(y) or abs(x-y)>0.5 for x,y in zip(ep,ap)):
                issues.append(f'line{i}.points')
    return issues

commands=[]
cases=[]
new_elapsed={version:0.0 for version in versions}
for mi,model in enumerate(['tiny','small','medium']):
    golden=json.loads((ROOT/'tests/baseline/expected'/(model+'.json')).read_text())
    for fi,fixture in enumerate(fixtures):
        job=ROOT/'target/pipeline-analysis-20261017-current'/(model+'-'+fixture+'.job.json')
        spec=json.loads(job.read_text())
        assert sha(Path(spec['pixels']))==spec['pixel_sha256']
        results={}
        order=list(versions) if (mi+fi)%2==0 else list(reversed(versions))
        for version in order:
            total_limit=args.baseline_total_limit_seconds if version=='baseline' else 60.0
            remaining=min(total_limit-ledger[version],25-new_elapsed[version])
            assert remaining>0, (version, 'execution budget exhausted')
            command=[str(versions[version]),'_worker',str(job)]
            stem=f'{model}-{fixture}-{version}'
            begin=time.monotonic()
            try:
                with (directory/(stem+'.json')).open('w') as output, (directory/(stem+'.log')).open('w') as error:
                    process=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,stdout=output,stderr=error,timeout=min(8,remaining))
            finally:
                elapsed=time.monotonic()-begin
                ledger[version]+=elapsed
                new_elapsed[version]+=elapsed
                ledger_path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
            commands.append(dict(command=command,version=version,elapsed_seconds=elapsed))
            assert process.returncode==0,(stem,process.returncode)
            result=json.loads((directory/(stem+'.json')).read_text())
            expected=next(c for c in golden['cases'] if c['id']==fixture)
            errors=compare(expected,result['result'])
            assert not errors,(stem,'golden mismatch',errors)
            results[version]=result
            print(stem,round(statistics.median(result['samples_ms']),3),'ms',round(elapsed,3),'s',flush=True)
        errors=compare(results['baseline']['result'],results[args.candidate]['result'])
        assert not errors,(model,fixture,'baseline/candidate output contract',errors)
        b=results['baseline']['samples_ms'];c=results[args.candidate]['samples_ms']
        bm=statistics.median(b);cm=statistics.median(c)
        cases.append(dict(model=model,fixture=fixture,order=order,baseline=results['baseline'],
                          candidate=results[args.candidate],baseline_median_ms=bm,candidate_median_ms=cm,
                          latency_reduction_percent=100*(bm-cm)/bm,
                          sample_ranges_overlap=not(max(b)<min(c) or max(c)<min(b)),
                          complete_outputs_exact=results['baseline']['result']==results[args.candidate]['result'],
                          output_contract_passed=True))
assert source=={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in sorted((ROOT/'src').rglob('*.rs'))}
report=dict(candidate=args.candidate,cases=cases,commands=commands,new_execution_seconds=new_elapsed,
            aggregate_execution_seconds_by_version=ledger,source_sha256=source,
            execution_limits_seconds={'baseline':args.baseline_total_limit_seconds,args.candidate:60.0,
                                      'per_comparison_per_version':25.0,'per_process':8.0},
            executable_sha256={v:sha(p) for v,p in versions.items()},
            settings='release/default;8threads;1request;autoNEON/layout/fusion;CLS;adaptive width;batch1;predecodedBGR24;owned',
            counts_per_version=dict(cases=len(cases),first=len(cases),warmups=len(cases),measured=3*len(cases)))
(directory/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Report:',directory/'report.json',flush=True)

import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import time

root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if (out/'focus-v1.json').exists():
    raise SystemExit('Fixed diagnostics have already run; preserve their samples.')
log=(out/'unit-v1.log').read_text()
assert 'test result: ok.' in log
binary=root/log.split('Running unittests src/lib.rs (',1)[1].split(')',1)[0]
ledger_path=out/'ledger.json'
ledger=json.loads(ledger_path.read_text()) if ledger_path.exists() else {
    'baseline':json.loads((out/'budget.json').read_text())['baseline_prior_seconds']}
ledger.setdefault('tail-v1',0.0)
cases=[('tail-v1',binary,'runtime::nhwc::pointwise::neon::blocked::arm64_pointwise_k_block_fixed_diagnostic'),
       ('baseline',out/'baseline-tests','runtime::optimized::tests::performance::sparse_detector_production_steps'),
       ('tail-v1',binary,'runtime::optimized::tests::performance::sparse_detector_production_steps')]
rows=[]
for version,executable,test in cases:
    command=[str(executable),test,'--exact','--ignored','--nocapture','--test-threads=1']
    begin=time.monotonic()
    result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=min(10,60-ledger[version]))
    elapsed=time.monotonic()-begin
